title: Support & Resources
headline: We’re here. You are not alone.

seo.title: LGBTQ+ support & resources at PoliTO | Collettivo Alan Turing
seo.description: Support and resources for LGBTQ+ and queer students at Politecnico di Torino (PoliTO). Contact Collettivo Alan Turing if you’re not sure where to start.

intro: Here we bring together information and resources that may help you find the support you need.
invitation: If you can’t find something that helps, or you’re not sure where to start, get in touch through our [Contact page](/contact/). We’re here, and we can look for a way forward together.
